services.desc: Discover the agricultural heritage that helped shape Winter Park. Golden Roots: The Citrus Legacy of Winter Park explores how citrus transformed the city’s economy, landscape, and community-and helped establish Central Florida’s reputation as a place of sunshine, health, and opportunity. Long before Winter Park became known as the “City of Homes,” orange groves, packing houses, and railroads were central to life in the growing community. Citrus attracted settlers, supported local businesses, and connected Winter Park to markets across the nation.
